name: adb-crash-dump
description: Capture all entries currently in the Android crash and system log buffers via `adb logcat -b crash,system -d`. Returns immediately with the full crash log — use this for one-shot diagnosis after a crash rather than for live monitoring (see android-logcat for live monitoring). Set ANDROID_SERIAL in the environment to target a specific device.

subcommand.name: default
subcommand.description: Dump the current crash and system log buffers. Output includes FATAL exceptions, ANR traces, native crashes, and tombstone markers.

options.name: v
options.description: Output format. Defaults to 'threadtime' (timestamp + thread). Other useful values: 'brief', 'long', 'tag'.

options.name: pid
options.description: Restrict output to a single PID. Resolve with adb-pid-of.

subcommand.install_instructions: Install ADB via Android Studio or: brew install android-platform-tools

custom.usage: Call after a crash to retrieve the full stack trace. Pass the output to the LLM for diagnosis and suggested fixes.
custom.deobfuscation: If the stack trace contains obfuscated class/method names, apply `retrace` using the R8/ProGuard mapping.txt from your build output: java -jar retrace.jar mapping.txt <stacktrace_file>
